findings.desc: review-discovered issue: stale passing verification evidence can mark a milestone completed. milestone_status currently accepts pass/waiver evidence without verifying the evidence head/material/storyFiles binding against the current story state, so old evidence can produce a false completed group.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by requiring covering evidence to be fresh against current materialHash/storyFilesHash when strong bindings exist, with stale-evidence status/risks and regression coverage in packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs. Full validate passed 33/33 commands.

findings.desc: review-discovered issue: milestones with no checklistRefs can still be reported completed. Empty checklistRefs pass vacuous every checks, letting a milestone with evidence but no checklist mapping hide a broken ledger mapping.

review-discovered issue: missing-ledger reporting can be preempted by checklist reads. A story with index metadata but no checklist throws before milestone_status can return its documented missing-ledger blocker.

packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts:133 and packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts:323: milestone_status still treats any pass or waiver verificationEvidence as covering without checking headHash, materialHash, or storyFilesHash freshness against current story material. A stale pass can move a row into the completed group, violating the no false DONE/completion semantics for this read-only report.

packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts:317 and packages/main/src/core/milestone-status.ts:334: checklistRefsComplete and checklistRefsValid are vacuously true for milestones with no checklistRefs, while verificationRefsCovered can be true from a standalone verificationIntentRef. That lets a ledger row with no checklist mapping appear completed, which makes milestone_status a second inferred completion system instead of a strict projection of authored milestone/checklist bindings.
